---
title: "Plotting Models"
---

Use `inputs/raw/nhanes_2021_2023_analysis.csv`. Fit a model, then plot its predictions **over the data**. Print the coefficient table and the F-test comparing the two models (with and without the age-by-gender interaction). Does the model look right? Compare the lines with binned means or residuals, in addition to the coefficient table.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```
